evidence.reason: The idle guard at src/ops/crq/publishRun.ts:447-453 treats absence of the request, pending outbox records, and the failure marker as idle. It does not consult a publication-owned queue halt. If recordFailure has halted the queue but its marker write failed, later runPublish calls take this branch, return idle, and never run reconciliation, so the halt persists. The comment above the failure path already intends to avoid stale halts; this is a missing recovery for the marker-write-failure case.
